title: Duality Switch
description: Players are paired into synchronized dual identities that alternate control of the same character.
body:
# Duality
Two players become permanently linked through a shared progression system.

Players are automatically assigned into paired roles (D and N).

Only one role group is active at a time. When the phase timer ends, the active players transfer their complete player state to their linked counterpart.

The inactive side becomes isolated until the next phase swap.

This creates a unique relay-style survival experience where two different people continuously inherit and continue the same journey.
